title: Add database migration framework to core crate
description:
Configure sqlx migrations for usenet-ipfs-core. Migrations live in core/migrations/. Embed migrations at compile time with sqlx::migrate!(). Provide a run_migrations(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<()> function that applies all pending migrations. Called at startup by both transit and reader before any storage operations. Artifact: core/src/migrations.rs.

Acceptance: sqlx migrate run works on a fresh database; embedded migrations match the files; running twice applies no duplicate migrations; migration version tracked in _sqlx_migrations table
